editorial.description_en: Deep shade in full leaf, which is darker and cooler than shade at any other time of year.
editorial.description_ja: 夏の木かげのような、暗く落ち着いた緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.560, C 0.072, h 158.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 夏 (natsu, summer) + 影 (kage, shadow). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Summer Shade" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 夏影. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — yama-kage at ΔE00 6.4, ja-mon at ΔE00 7.3, sabi-do at ΔE00 7.6. complementary is empty because no entry in this corpus sits within 22° of the opposite hue. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
